note: D5 defines 60 new NFR ids and cites 22 belonging to earlier units. High-water marks were recomputed across BOTH records and the whole aidlc tree before numbering: zero collisions, verified. Nine Deferred rows, each naming a designed obligation whose verifier is manual, absent or a human step - not unaddressed work wearing a label. Zero GAP rows. D5 writes nothing, so the concurrency requirements D1-D4 carried are inapplicable and are named individually rather than dropped silently.

construction/knowing-how-it-is-going/nfr-requirements/tech-stack-decisions.md section 3 - No reporting or BI framework; every figure would then be computed where the money import boundary does not reach

construction/knowing-how-it-is-going/nfr-requirements/scalability-requirements.md section 1 - The seat set is what grows; the statement-count assertions hold the cost flat as it does
construction/knowing-how-it-is-going/nfr-requirements/scalability-requirements.md section 1 - Request rate does not grow with scale; no throughput or rate-limit requirement is set and none is claimed

construction/knowing-how-it-is-going/nfr-requirements/scalability-requirements.md section 1 - No write at all, so no concurrency guarantee. Verified by a test asserting the reads leave every table byte-identical, which fails on a write added later

construction/knowing-how-it-is-going/nfr-requirements/scalability-requirements.md section 2 - READ consistency, which IS applicable: each read computes from one snapshot so a mid-read receipt cannot make the balance and the oldest-unpaid-period disagree

construction/knowing-how-it-is-going/nfr-requirements/scalability-requirements.md section 3 - The fold is sized for the stated ceiling and no further. NO VERIFIER and the trigger (a teacher exceeding the nominal batch count by an order of magnitude) is UNWATCHED, stated plainly because a bound with an unwatched trigger is this project recorded failure shape

construction/knowing-how-it-is-going/nfr-requirements/security-requirements.md section 4 - Governance stays at 25; the built test asserts BOTH directions, and the second is what catches a stale entry naming a table that does not exist
construction/knowing-how-it-is-going/nfr-requirements/security-requirements.md section 4 - No migration; a file check plus the hand-updated head-revision assertions
construction/knowing-how-it-is-going/nfr-requirements/security-requirements.md section 1 - Every figure scoped by the lens owner_id, never by an id from the request

construction/knowing-how-it-is-going/nfr-requirements/security-requirements.md section 1 - The probe asserts the figure VALUE against seeded data, because a probe asserting only a 200 with a number passes against a figure summed across two teachers
construction/knowing-how-it-is-going/nfr-requirements/security-requirements.md section 1 - No non-teacher lens reaches these reads; the built route-enumeration test plus a probe per route
construction/knowing-how-it-is-going/nfr-requirements/security-requirements.md section 1 - No PUBLIC_ROUTES entry; the count is asserted at tests/contract/test_route_lenses.py lines 76 and 104

construction/knowing-how-it-is-going/nfr-requirements/security-requirements.md section 2 - No owner-private profile field or global account id; the built app/contract/privacy.py gate iterates the generated document

construction/knowing-how-it-is-going/nfr-requirements/security-requirements.md section 2 - The gate catches the schema and NOTHING CATCHES A DESIGN DECISION to render a photo beside a debt. Review only, stated as the honest half

construction/knowing-how-it-is-going/nfr-requirements/security-requirements.md section 2 - A declined seat is absent whatever it owes; the probe needs a declined OWING seat, which a test using only pending and accepted seats cannot distinguish

construction/knowing-how-it-is-going/nfr-requirements/security-requirements.md section 3 - No RLS policy because no table is created. A RECORDED DECISION; the probe suite is what actually enforces the boundary
construction/knowing-how-it-is-going/nfr-requirements/security-requirements.md section 3 - Reads run as the granted non-superuser APP_ROLE; the built meta-test gates the privacy package

construction/knowing-how-it-is-going/nfr-requirements/security-requirements.md section 5 - ZAP baseline against the staging host driven from the committed openapi.json; both prerequisites verified present
construction/knowing-how-it-is-going/nfr-requirements/security-requirements.md section 5 - Not a merge gate; placed in the release workflow where team.md puts it
construction/knowing-how-it-is-going/nfr-requirements/security-requirements.md section 5 - High blocks the promotion, lower annotates, following the two-speed CVE model and for the same stated reason

construction/knowing-how-it-is-going/nfr-requirements/security-requirements.md section 5 - The scan reaches only UNAUTHENTICATED surface because D5 gives it no token. NO VERIFIER BEYOND THE SCAN; the requirement exists so a green run is not misread as covering authenticated routes

construction/knowing-how-it-is-going/nfr-requirements/tech-stack-decisions.md section 2 - New modules land under the existing five strict mypy islands or the global disallow_untyped_defs; mypy app is already a make check gate
construction/knowing-how-it-is-going/nfr-requirements/tech-stack-decisions.md section 4 - Two screens following the built feature layer convention with no new pattern, module or dependency
construction/knowing-how-it-is-going/nfr-requirements/tech-stack-decisions.md section 4 - Both string bundles and a row per screen; MessageKeyCoverageTest for any new key

construction/knowing-how-it-is-going/nfr-requirements/reliability-requirements.md section 1 - Every money figure from the built fold; the import-boundary checks fail make check on raw decimal outside app/money

construction/knowing-how-it-is-going/nfr-requirements/reliability-requirements.md section 1 - Month from the period key, never created_at. The named test uses an entry whose period is October and whose created_at is November

construction/knowing-how-it-is-going/nfr-requirements/reliability-requirements.md section 1 - The fold selects by kind, never sums amounts: amount is non-negative and the sign lives in the kind, so SUM(amount) adds charges to receipts
construction/knowing-how-it-is-going/nfr-requirements/reliability-requirements.md section 1 - A figure that cannot be computed is an error, never a zero, because zero is reserved for nothing received
construction/knowing-how-it-is-going/nfr-requirements/reliability-requirements.md section 2 - Four distinct kinds of nothing, a test per row; collapsing any pair is the defect

construction/knowing-how-it-is-going/nfr-requirements/reliability-requirements.md section 2 - None of the four is a 404 or 5xx, with the status asserted per case because not-a-200 passes against all three wrong answers
construction/knowing-how-it-is-going/nfr-requirements/reliability-requirements.md section 3 - No new exception class and no new error code; the built error-contract test with no new mechanism
construction/knowing-how-it-is-going/nfr-requirements/reliability-requirements.md section 3 - Retryability stays a property of the class, read in one place

construction/knowing-how-it-is-going/nfr-requirements/reliability-requirements.md section 4 - One consistent snapshot per read, so figures within a response agree. The one reliability property D5 does not inherit
construction/knowing-how-it-is-going/nfr-requirements/reliability-requirements.md section 5 - The reads leave every table byte-identical, asserted rather than reviewed

construction/knowing-how-it-is-going/nfr-requirements/performance-requirements.md section 1 - Constant statement count for the dues read, verified by a statement-count assertion following D3 NFR20.18, never a latency assertion

construction/knowing-how-it-is-going/nfr-requirements/performance-requirements.md section 1 - The oldest unpaid period comes from the same in-memory per_cycle map, pinned to the built function value by a test so the reimplementation matches rather than merely being cheap
construction/knowing-how-it-is-going/nfr-requirements/performance-requirements.md section 1 - Constant statement count for all three overview blocks together
construction/knowing-how-it-is-going/nfr-requirements/performance-requirements.md section 1 - No join to fee_cycle for the month grouping, because period is a plain string on the ledger row

construction/knowing-how-it-is-going/nfr-requirements/performance-requirements.md section 1 - No index beyond the existing constraints is required; stated so the absence is a decision rather than an oversight

construction/knowing-how-it-is-going/nfr-requirements/observability-requirements.md section 1 - No child name in a log line. REVIEW ONLY, NOTHING AUTOMATED CHECKS IT, and it carries more weight here than in D4 because a dues row pairs a name with a debt
